claims.text: Ask the parent: something the child does that makes them proud; concerns about behavior, physical well-being or special health care needs; development or learning; how the child enjoys school, social or academic concerns, friendships, bullying; mood or behavior concerns.
claims.quote: Tell me something your child does that makes you proud. • What are your concerns about your child’s behavioral, physical well-being, or special health care needs? • Do you have any concerns about your child’s development or learning? How is your child enjoying school? What concerns do you have about his social or academic experience? Are you concerned about your child’s friendships? Bullying? • Please share any concerns you may have about your child’s mood or behavior (eg, attention, hitting, temper, worries, not participating in play with others, irritability, mood, or activity level)?
